list.name: tz
list.label: Time zone
list.description: For the daily panels: an IANA name, such as Europe/Berlin

targets.query: SELECT last("battery_v") AS "Battery" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("battery_soc_pct") AS "SOC" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("charging_state") AS "State" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("pv_v") AS "PV V" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("pv_w") AS "PV" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("controller_temp_c") * 9 / 5 + 32 AS "Temperature" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Sun tomorrow

targets.query: SELECT last("sunshine_h") AS "Sunshine" FROM "weather_daily" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND time > now() AND time < now() + 1d

panels.description: Forecast hours of sunshine for tomorrow. Weather: Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com, CC BY 4.0), model estimates for the location, not a measurement at the panel.

targets.query: SELECT mean("battery_v") AS "Battery V" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("pv_v") AS "PV V" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("battery_soc_pct") AS "SOC" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("pv_w") AS "PV W" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("battery_charge_a") AS "Charge A" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Sun

targets.query: SELECT mean("radiation_w_m2") AS "Sunlight" FROM "weather" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("cloud_cover_pct") AS "Cloud cover" FROM "weather" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("pv_w") AS "PV W" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("precipitation_mm") AS "Rain" FROM "weather" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.description: Sunlight on a flat surface (W/m², shaded), cloud cover (%, dashed) and rain (mm per 15 minutes, blue bars; rain and snow, as water), with the panel's PV W (right axis). Low PV under a low sun is the weather; low PV under a high sun is the panel, or a full battery taking little. Weather: Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com, CC BY 4.0), model estimates for the location, not a measurement at the panel.

targets.query: SELECT last("charging_state") AS "State" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("controller_temp_c") * 9 / 5 + 32 AS "Controller" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT last("operating_days") AS "Operating days" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("pv_total_wh") AS "PV energy" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("charge_total_ah") AS "Charged" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("over_discharges") AS "Over-discharges" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("full_charges") AS "Full charges" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("faults") AS "Faults" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: PV energy per day

targets.query: SELECT sum("p") / 12 AS "Into the battery" FROM (SELECT mean("p") AS "p" FROM (SELECT "battery_v" * "battery_charge_a" AS "p" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter) WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(5m)) WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.description: The energy the battery took each day: battery voltage × charge current, from the 5-minute readings. Missing readings count as nothing. A full battery takes little, whatever the sun.

panels.title: Sun per day

targets.query: SELECT last("sunshine_h") AS "Sunshine" FROM "weather_daily" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT last("radiation_kwh_m2") AS "Sunlight" FROM "weather_daily" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.description: Hours of sunshine, and the day's sunlight on a flat surface (kWh/m², right axis). Today's is the forecast for the whole day. Weather: Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com, CC BY 4.0), model estimates for the location, not a measurement at the panel.

panels.title: Rain per day

targets.query: SELECT last("precipitation_mm") AS "Rain" FROM "weather_daily" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT last("snowfall_cm") AS "Snow" FROM "weather_daily" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT last("precipitation_h") AS "Hours" FROM "weather_daily" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.description: The day's rain, showers and snow as water (mm), snowfall (cm), and the hours with any (right axis). Today's is the forecast for the whole day. Weather: Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com, CC BY 4.0), model estimates for the location, not a measurement at the panel.

panels.title: Yield per day

targets.query: SELECT sum("p") / 12 AS "Battery Wh" FROM (SELECT mean("p") AS "p" FROM (SELECT "battery_v" * "battery_charge_a" AS "p" FROM "charge_controller" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter) WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(5m)) WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("radiation_w_m2") / 4000 AS "Sun kWh" FROM "weather" WHERE "controller" =~ /^$controller$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.description: The day's energy into the battery per kWh/m² of sunlight. Level from day to day while the battery takes all the panel gives; it drops on a day the battery is full and the controller holds back, and when something is wrong at the panel (dirt, shade). Weather: Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com, CC BY 4.0), model estimates for the location, not a measurement at the panel.

panels.title: Battery voltage, daily min and max
